```
---
description: "Use when creating, editing or reviewing test scenarios (scenariusz testowy, test scenario, TS-, pokrycie AC, priorytet, planned test cases) in docs/test-scenario. Covers required structure, AC coverage, priority rationale, test techniques and bad practices."
applyTo: "docs/test-scenario/**"

# Zasady tworzenia scenariuszy testowych

Scenariusz opisuje cel użytkownika lub ścieżkę, nie pojedynczy test.

Wszystkie punkty poniżej są twarde (MUST). Treść artefaktu pisz po angielsku.

## Struktura i treść

- Tytuł opisuje cel użytkownika lub ścieżkę, nie pojedynczy test.
- `Covered acceptance criteria` odwołuje się do ID AC z user story.
- Każde AC z user story jest pokryte przez co najmniej jeden scenariusz albo jawnie oznaczone jako niepokryte.
- `Preconditions` opisują stan (system, dane, konto, adres aplikacji), nie kroki.
- `Planned test cases` to tabela z kolumnami: TC ID, tytuł, typ (positive, negative, boundary), technika (klasy równoważności, wartości brzegowe, tablica decyzyjna, przejścia stanów), priorytet, AC.
- Scenariusz zawiera ścieżkę pozytywną i negatywną. Wartości brzegowe dodawaj tam, gdzie reguła ma próg.
- Granice scenariusza (co jest poza zakresem) opisz w `Notes`.
- Nieznane wartości zapisz jako `TBD` i dodaj wpis w `Open questions`.

## Priorytet

- Uzasadnij priorytet ryzykiem i wpływem biznesowym w `Notes`.
- Nie oznaczaj wszystkich przypadków jako High.

## Zakazy (MUST NOT)

- Szczegółowych kroków testowych (należą do test-case).
- Konkretnych danych wejściowych (należą do test-data).
- Dublowania pokrycia tych samych AC bez uzasadnienia.
- AC bez żadnego przypadku testowego.
- Priorytetu bez uzasadnienia.
- Scenariusza równego jednemu przypadkowi testowemu.
```

```
# TS-KOS-01 - Customer keeps cart items across page reload, login and the 5-product limit

## Goal

Verify that products added to the cart by a guest and by a registered customer are kept, that the carts are merged after login, and that the 5-different-products limit is enforced with the defined message. Cart items are the entry point to checkout, so a lost or silently changed cart directly blocks the purchase.

## Covered acceptance criteria

- AC-1: guest adds a product from an available product page
- AC-2: guest cart items remain after page reload
- AC-3: guest cart merged with account cart after login (resulting quantity TBD)
- AC-4: 6th different product is rejected with the limit message
- AC-5: guest cart with a different product merges with account cart after login

## Preconditions

| # | Condition | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | System | TBD (OS, browser) |
| 2 | Application | http://localhost:3000 is loaded; product page /products/sluchawki-soundmax-x3 is available (stock > 0) |
| 3 | User | Guest (not logged in) for AC-1 and AC-2; registered customer with an existing cart for AC-3 and AC-4 (test account per konta-testowe.md) |

## Planned test cases

| TC ID | Title | Type | Technique | Priority | AC |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-KOS-001 | Guest adds an available product to the cart | positive | equivalence classes | High | AC-1 |
| TC-KOS-002 | Guest cart items are still shown after page reload | positive | state transition | High | AC-2 |
| TC-KOS-003 | Guest cart merges with account cart after login (same product) | positive | state transition | High | AC-3 |
| TC-KOS-004 | Adding a 6th different product shows the limit message | boundary | boundary values | High | AC-4 |
| TC-KOS-005 | Adding a 5th different product is accepted | boundary | boundary values
… (output truncated)
```

```
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Convert test scenario markdown files (docs/test-scenario) to one Excel workbook.

Usage:
    python scripts/test_scenario_to_xlsx.py                      # all of docs/test-scenario
    python scripts/test_scenario_to_xlsx.py FILE_OR_DIR ... -o out.xlsx

Requires: pip install openpyxl
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Alignment, Font, PatternFill
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
DEFAULT_INPUT = ROOT / "docs" / "test-scenario"
DEFAULT_OUTPUT = ROOT / "docs" / "test-scenario" / "test-scenarios.xlsx"

HEADER_FILL = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="1F4E78")
HEADER_FONT = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
WRAP = Alignment(wrap_text=True, vertical="top")


def parse_frontmatter(text: str) -> tuple[dict[str, str], str]:
    match = re.match(r"^---\r?\n(.*?)\r?\n---\r?\n", text, re.DOTALL)
    if not match:
        return {}, text
    meta = {}
    for line in match.group(1).splitlines():
        key, sep, value = line.partition(":")
        if sep:
            meta[key.strip()] = value.strip().strip("\"'")
    return meta, text[match.end():]


def split_sections(body: str) -> tuple[str, dict[str, str]]:
    """Return the H1 title and a map of H2 heading -> section text."""
    title = ""
    sections: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    current: str | None = None
    for line in body.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("# ") and not title:
            title = line[2:].strip()
        elif line.startswith("## "):
            current = line[3:].strip()
            sections[current] = []
        elif current is not None:
            sections[current].append(line)
    return title, {k: "\n".join(v).strip() for k, v in sections.items()}


def parse_table(text: str) -> tuple[list[str], list[list[str]]]:
    rows = []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line.startswith("|"):
            continue
        cells = [c.strip() for c in re.split(r"(?<!\\)\|", line.strip("|"))]
        if all(re.fullmatch(r":?-{3,}:?", c) for c in cells):
            continue
        rows.append([c.replace("\\|", "|") for c in cells])
    return (rows[0], rows[1:]) if rows else ([], [])


def parse_bullets(text: str) -> list[str]:
    return [m.group(1).strip() for m in re.finditer(r"^\s*[-*]\s+(.*)$", text, re.MULTILINE)]


def strip_md(value: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[`*]", "", value)


class Scenario:
    def __init__(self, path: Path):
        self.path = path
        meta, body = parse_frontmatter(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.meta = meta
        self.title, self.sections = split_sections(body)
        self.id = meta.get("id", path.stem)

    def table(self, name: str) -> tuple[list[str], list[list[str]]]:
        return parse_table(self.sections.get(name, ""))

    def bullets(self, name: str) -> list[str]:
        return parse_bullets(self.sections.get(name, ""))


def add_sheet(wb: Workbook, name: str, header: list[str], rows: list[list[str]], widths: list[int]) -> None:
    ws = wb.create_sheet(name)
    ws.append(header)
    for row in rows:
        ws.append([strip_md(str(c)) for c in row])
    for cell in ws[1]:
        cell.fill, cell.font, cell.alignment = HEADER_FILL, HEADER_FONT, WRAP
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2):
        for cell in row:
            cell.alignment = WRAP
    for i, width in enumerate(widths, start=1):
        ws.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(i)].width = width
    ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
    ws.auto_filter.ref = ws.dimensions


def build_workbook(scenarios: list[Scenario]) -> Workbook:
    wb = Workbook()
    wb.remove(wb.active)

    overview = [
        [s.id, s.meta.get("story", ""), s.meta.get("title", s.title), s.meta.get("status", ""),
         s.meta.get("priority", ""), s.sections.get("Goal", ""), "\n".join(s.bullets("Notes")), s.path.name]
        for s in scenarios
    ]
    add_sheet(wb, "Scenarios",
              ["Scenario ID", "Story", "Title", "Status", "Priority", "Goal", "Notes", "Source file"],
              overview, [14, 14, 40, 12, 10, 60, 80, 40])

    cases, ac_rows, pre_rows, td_rows, oq_rows = [], [], [], [], []
    case_header: list[str] = []
    for s in scenarios:
        header, rows = s.table("Planned test cases")
        case_header = case_header or header
        cases += [[s.id] + r for r in rows]
        ac_rows += [[s.id, b] for b in s.bullets("Covered acceptance criteria")]
        _, rows = s.table("Preconditions")
        pre_rows += [[s.id] + r for r in rows]
        td_rows += [[s.id, b] for b in s.bullets("Test data")]
        _, rows = s.table("Open questions")
        oq_rows += [[s.id] + r for r in rows]

    add_sheet(wb, "Test Cases", ["Scenario ID"] + (case_header or ["TC ID", "Title", "Type", "Technique", "Priority", "AC"]),
              cases, [14, 16, 60, 12, 22, 10, 10])
    add_sheet(wb, "Covered AC", ["Scenario ID", "Acceptance criterion"], ac_rows, [14, 100])
    add_sheet(wb, "Preconditions", ["Scenario ID", "#", "Condition", "Description"], pre_rows, [14, 5, 16, 100])
    add_sheet(wb, "Test Data", ["Scenario ID", "Test data"], td_rows, [14, 100])
    add_sheet(wb, "Open Questions", ["Scenario ID", "#", "Question", "Owner", "Status"], oq_rows, [14, 5, 100, 18, 10])
    return wb


def collect_files(inputs: list[Path]) -> list[Path]:
    files: list[Path] = []
    for p in inputs:
        files += sorted(p.rglob("*.test-scenario.md")) if p.is_dir() else [p]
    return files


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    parser.add_argument("inputs", nargs="*", type=Path, default=[DEFAULT_INPUT], help="scenario files or directories")
    parser.add_argument("-o", "--output", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_OUTPUT, help="output .xlsx path")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    files = collect_files(args.inputs)
    if not files:
        print("No test scenario files found.", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    wb = build_workbook([Scenario(f) for f in files])
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    wb.save(args.output)
    print(f"Saved {args.output} ({len(files)} scenario file(s))")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

```

````
Koordynuje tworzenie, zmianę i przegląd user story oraz jego artefaktów testowych (testy manualne). Procedury, checklisty, szablony i przykłady ładuj dopiero wtedy, gdy są potrzebne (macierz w kroku 2).
````

````
# [Agent Skills (SKILL.md)](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/customization/agent-skills)

Folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that agents load on-demand for specialized tasks.

## Structure

```
.github/skills/<skill-name>/
├── SKILL.md           # Required (name must match folder)
├── scripts/           # Executable code
├── references/        # Docs loaded as needed
└── assets/            # Templates, boilerplate
```

## Locations

| Path | Scope |
|------|-------|
| `.github/skills/<name>/` | Project |
| `.agents/skills/<name>/` | Project |
| `.claude/skills/<name>/` | Project |
| `~/.copilot/skills/<name>/` | Personal |
| `~/.agents/skills/<name>/` | Personal |
| `~/.claude/skills/<name>/` | Personal |

## SKILL.md Format

```yaml
---
name: skill-name              # Required: 1-64 chars, lowercase alphanumeric + hyphens, must match folder
description: 'What and when to use. Max 1024 chars.'
argument-hint: 'Optional hint shown for slash invocation'
user-invocable: true          # Optional: show as slash command (default: true)
disable-model-invocation: false # Optional: disable automatic model-triggered loading
---
```

### Body

- What the skill accomplishes
- When to use (triggers and use cases)
- Step-by-step procedures
- References to resources: `[script](./scripts/test.js)`

## Template

```markdown
---
name: webapp-testing
description: 'Test web applications using Playwright. Use for verifying frontend, debugging UI, capturing screenshots.'
---

# Web Application Testing

## When to Use
- Verify frontend functionality
- Debug UI behavior

## Procedure
1. Start the web server
2. Run [test script](./scripts/test.js)
3. Review screenshots in `./screenshots/`
```

## Progressive Loading

1. **Discovery** (~100 tokens): Agent reads `name` and `description`
2. **Instructions** (<5000 tokens): Loads `SKILL.md` body when relevant
3. **Resources**: Additional files load only when referenced

Keep file references one level deep from `SKILL.md`.
````

```
# US-REG-01 - Registration form validation

## Story

As a guest creating a new account, I want the registration form to tell me immediately which fields are invalid, so that I can correct them and complete registration without guessing.

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC-1** [REG-01, screenshot 07] Given a guest on `/register`, When the page loads, Then the form shows the fields "Imię i nazwisko", "E-mail", "Hasło", "Powtórz hasło" and the button "Zarejestruj się".
- **AC-2** [REG-02, screenshot 08] Given the field "Imię i nazwisko" contains fewer than 2 characters, When the form is validated, Then the message "Imię i nazwisko wymagane (min. 2 znaki)" is shown under the field.
- **AC-3** [REG-02, screenshot 08] Given the field "E-mail" contains a value that is not an e-mail address, When the form is validated, Then the message "Nieprawidłowy format e-mail" is shown under the field.
- **AC-4** [REG-02, BR-10, screenshot 08] Given the field "Hasło" contains fewer than 8 characters, When the form is validated, Then the message "Min. 8 znaków" is shown under the field.
- **AC-5** [REG-01, screenshot 08] Given the value of "Powtórz hasło" differs from "Hasło", When the form is validated, Then the message "Hasła nie są zgodne" is shown under "Powtórz hasło".

## Scope

**In scope**
- Client-visible validation of the four registration fields.

**Out of scope**
- E-mail verification and account activation (REG-03).
- Login, password reset.

## Related requirements

- REG-01: registration with name, e-mail, password, password confirmation
- REG-02: field validation (e-mail format and uniqueness, password rules, all fields required)
- BR-10: password min. 8 characters, min. 1 digit, min. 1 special character

- Scenarios: TS-REG-01 (registration-form-validation)
```

```
# US-KOS-01 - Cart availability for guest and registered customer

## Story

As a customer (guest or registered), I want my cart items to be kept after a page reload, across sessions for a registered account, and after I log in, so that I can continue my purchase.

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC-1** [KOS-01] Given a guest on an available product page, When the guest clicks "Dodaj do koszyka", Then the product is added to the cart.
- **AC-2** [KOS-02, user answer] Given a guest has items in the cart, When the page is reloaded, Then the guest cart items are still shown.
- **AC-3** [KOS-02, user answer] Given a guest has added SoundMax X3 and the account already has SoundMax X3 in the cart, When the guest logs in, Then the carts are merged and the resulting quantity for SoundMax X3 is TBD.
- **AC-4** [KOS-04, KOS-05, BR-01] Given the cart contains 5 different products, When the customer adds a 6th different product, Then the message "Osiągnięto limit pozycji dla konta standardowego (5). Usuń produkt lub przejdź na konto Premium." is shown.
- **AC-5** [user answer] Given a guest has a product in the cart and the account has a different product in the cart, When the guest logs in, Then the carts are merged and both products are in the resulting cart.

## Scope

**In scope**
- Adding products to the cart as a guest.
- Keeping the cart between sessions for a registered customer.
- Merging the guest cart with the account cart after login.
- Limit of 5 different products.

**Out of scope**
- Discount codes (KOS-07).
- Stock change alert before checkout (KOS-08).
- Checkout steps (CHK-01 to CHK-11).

## Related requirements

- KOS-01: guest and registered customer can add products to the cart
- KOS-02: cart of a registered customer persists between sessions
```

```
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Two-way sync between user-story-writer markdown artifacts and Excel workbooks.

Markdown (docs/user-story, test-scenario, test-case, test-data) <-> one workbook per type.
Sheet and column names come from ../assets/config.json. See ../SKILL.md for the procedure.

    python excel_sync.py template [--type T] [--out DIR]
    python excel_sync.py status   [--type T] [--id ID]
    python excel_sync.py sync     [--type T] [--id ID] [--prefer md|xlsx]

Requires: pip install openpyxl
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import re
import sys
import unicodedata
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from openpyxl import Workbook, load_workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Alignment, Font, PatternFill
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

SKILL_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
DEFAULT_CONFIG = SKILL_DIR / "assets" / "config.json"
TEMPLATE_DIR = SKILL_DIR / "assets" / "templates"
SYNC_SHEET = "_sync"

HEADER_FILL = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="1F4E78")
HEADER_FONT = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
WRAP = Alignment(wrap_text=True, vertical="top")
WIDTHS = {
    "story": 50, "goal": 60, "notes": 80, "criterion": 60, "question": 60, "description": 60,
    "action": 50, "expected": 50, "title": 40, "purpose": 40, "preconditions": 50,
    "postconditions": 50, "conventions": 60, "extra": 60, "in_scope": 40, "out_of_scope": 40,
    "related": 40, "linked": 30, "file": 40, "heading": 40, "scenario_title": 40,
}

Q_COLS = [("no", "#"), ("question", "Question"), ("owner", "Owner"), ("status", "Status")]
PRE_COLS = [("no", "#"), ("condition", "Condition"), ("description", "Description")]
CASE_COLS = [("tc_id", "TC ID"), ("title", "Title"), ("type", "Type"), ("technique", "Technique"),
             ("priority", "Priority"), ("ac", "AC")]
STEP_COLS = [("no", "#"), ("action", "Action"), ("expected", "Expected result"), ("test_data", "Test data")]
DATA_INTRO = "Columns after `Class` are the input fields used by the scenario."


# ---------- markdown helpers ----------

def norm_text(v) -> str:
    if v is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(v, float) and v.is_integer():
        v = int(v)
    return re.sub(r"\r\n?", "\n", str(v)).strip()


def parse_frontmatter(text: str) -> tuple[dict, str]:
    m = re.match(r"^---\r?\n(.*?)\r?\n---\r?\n", text, re.S)
    if not m:
        return {}, text
    meta = {}
    for line in m.group(1).splitlines():
        k, sep, v = line.partition(":")
        if sep:
            meta[k.strip()] = v.strip().strip("\"'")
    return meta, text[m.end():]


def split_h2(body: str) -> tuple[str, list[tuple[str, str]]]:
    h1, sections = "", []
    for line in body.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("# ") and not h1 and not sections:
            h1 = line[2:].strip()
        elif line.startswith("## "):
            sections.append([line[3:].strip(), []])
        elif sections:
            sections[-1][1].append(line)
    return h1, [(h, "\n".join(t).strip()) for h, t in sections]


def split_heading(h1: str, key: str) -> str:
    m = re.search(rf"{re.escape(key)}\s*[-–—]\s*(.*)$", h1)
    return m.group(1).strip() if m else h1


def split_cells(line: str) -> list[str]:
    cells = re.split(r"(?<!\\)\|", line.strip().strip("|"))
    return [c.strip().replace("\\|", "|").replace("<br>", "\n") for c in cells]


def table_blocks(text: str) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
    """Line ranges [start, end) of contiguous table blocks."""
    lines, blocks, start = text.splitlines(), [], None
    for i, line in enumerate(lines + [""]):
        is_row = line.strip().startswith("|")
        if is_row and start is None:
            start = i
        elif not is_row and start is not None:
            blocks.append((start, i))
            start = None
    return blocks


def parse_table(text: str) -> tuple[list[str], list[list[str]]]:
    rows = []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if not line.strip().startswith("|"):
            continue
        cells = split_cells(line)
        if all(re.fullmatch(r":?-{3,}:?", c) for c in cells):
            continue
        rows.append(cells)
    return (rows[0], rows[1:]) if rows else ([], [])


def rows_from_table(text: str, cols: list[tuple[str, str]], ref: str) -> list[dict]:
    keys = [k for k, _ in cols]
    _, rows = parse_table(text)
    return [{"ref": ref, **dict(zip(keys, (r + [""] * len(keys))[:len(keys)]))} for r in rows]


def bullet_items(text: str) -> list[str]:
    return [m.group(1).strip() for m in re.finditer(r"^\s*[-*]\s+(.*)$", text, re.M)]


def parse_bullets(text: str) -> str:
    return "\n".join(bullet_items(text))


def render_table(header: list[str], rows: list[list[str]]) -> str:
    esc = lambda c: str(c).replace("|", "\\|").replace("\n", "<br>")
    lines = ["| " + " | ".join(esc(h) for h in header) + " |", "|" + "---|" * len(header)]
    lines += ["| " + " | ".join(esc(c) for c in r) + " |" for r in rows]
    return "\n".join(lines)


def table(cols: list[tuple[str, str]], rows: list[dict]) -> str:
    return render_table([h for _, h in cols], [[r[k] for k, _ in cols] for r in rows])


def render_bullets(value: str) -> str:
    return "\n".join(f"- {line}" for line in value.splitlines() if line.strip())


def yq(v: str) -> str:
    if v and re.search(r"(^[\s\[\]{}\"'&*!|>%@`#-]|:\s|\s#|\s$)", v):
        return json.dumps(v, ensure_ascii=False)
    return v


def block(title: str, body: str) -> str:
    return f"## {title}\n\n{body}".rstrip() + "\n"


def doc_text(front: list[tuple[str, str]], h1: str, blocks: list[str]) -> str:
    head = "---\n" + "\n".join(f"{k}: {v}" for k, v in front) + "\n---\n"
    return head + f"\n# {h1}\n\n" + "\n".join(blocks).rstrip() + "\n"


# ---------- adapters: markdown <-> canonical doc ----------
# doc = {"key", "main": {...}, "children": {sheet_key: [row, ...]}, "unmapped": [heading, ...]}

AC_RE = re.compile(r"^\*\*(AC-[\w-]+)\*\*\s*(?:\[(.*?)\])?\s*(.*)$", re.S)


def parse_user_story(meta, h1, sections):
    s, key = dict(sections), meta.get("id", "")
    scope = s.get("Scope", "")
    mi = re.search(r"\*\*In scope\*\*(.*?)(?=\*\*Out of scope\*\*|\Z)", scope, re.S)
    mo = re.search(r"\*\*Out of scope\*\*(.*)", scope, re.S)
    criteria = []
    for item in bullet_items(s.get("Acceptance criteria", "")):
        m = AC_RE.match(item)
        criteria.append({"ref": key, "ac": m.group(1), "source": m.group(2) or "", "criterion": m.group(3)}
                        if m else {"ref": key, "ac": "", "source": "", "criterion": item})
    main = {
        "id": key, "title": meta.get("title") or split_heading(h1, key), "status": meta.get("status", ""),
        "requirements": ", ".join(p.strip() for p in meta.get("requirements", "").strip("[]").split(",") if p.strip()),
        "story": s.get("Story", ""), "in_scope": parse_bullets(mi.group(1)) if mi else "",
        "out_of_scope": parse_bullets(mo.group(1)) if mo else "",
        "related": parse_bullets(s.get("Related requirements", "")),
        "linked": parse_bullets(s.get("Linked artifacts", "")), "file": "",
    }
    known = {"Story", "Acceptance criteria", "Scope", "Related requirements", "Linked artifacts", "Open questions"}
    return {"key": key, "main": main, "unmapped": [h for h, _ in sections if h not in known],
            "children": {"criteria": criteria,
                         "questions": rows_from_table(s.get("Open questions", ""), Q_COLS, key)}}


def render_user_story(doc):
    m, c = doc["main"], doc["children"]
    front = [("id", m["id"]), ("type", "user-story"), ("title", yq(m["title"])), ("status", m["status"]),
             ("requirements", f"[{m['requirements']}]")]
    ac = [f"- **{r['ac']}** " + (f"[{r['source']}] " if r["source"] else "") + r["criterion"] for r in c["criteria"]]
    scope = (f"**In scope**\n{render_bullets(m['in_scope'])}\n\n"
             f"**Out of scope**\n{render_bullets(m['out_of_scope'])}")
    return doc_text(front, f"{m['id']} - {m['title']}", [
        block("Story", m["story"]), block("Acceptance criteria", "\n".join(ac)), block("Scope", scope),
        block("Related requirements", render_bullets(m["related"])),
        block("Linked artifacts", render_bullets(m["linked"])),
        block("Open questions", table(Q_COLS, c["questions"])),
    ])


def parse_test_scenario(meta, h1, sections):
    s, key = dict(sections), meta.get("id", "")
    main = {
        "id": key, "story": meta.get("story", ""), "title": meta.get("title", ""),
        "heading": split_heading(h1, key), "status": meta.get("status", ""), "priority": meta.get("priority", ""),
        "goal": s.get("Goal", ""), "test_data": parse_bullets(s.get("Test data", "")),
        "notes": parse_bullets(s.get("Notes", "")), "file": "",
    }
    known = {"Goal", "Covered acceptance criteria", "Preconditions", "Planned test cases", "Test data",
             "Notes", "Open questions"}
    return {"key": key, "main": main, "unmapped": [h for h, _ in sections if h not in known],
            "children": {
                "covered_ac": [{"ref": key, "ac": i} for i in bullet_items(s.get("Covered acceptance criteria", ""))],
                "preconditions": rows_from_table(s.get("Preconditions", ""), PRE_COLS, key),
                "cases": rows_from_table(s.get("Planned test cases", ""), CASE_COLS, key),
                "questions": rows_from_table(s.get("Open questions", ""), Q_COLS, key)}}


def render_test_scenario(doc):
    m, c = doc["main"], doc["children"]
    front = [("id", m["id"]), ("type", "test-scenario"), ("story", m["story"]), ("title", yq(m["title"])),
             ("status", m["status"]), ("priority", m["priority"])]
    return doc_text(front, f"{m['id']} - {m['heading'] or m['title']}", [
        block("Goal", m["goal"]),
        block("Covered acceptance criteria", render_bullets("\n".join(r["ac"] for r in c["covered_ac"]))),
        block("Preconditions", table(PRE_COLS, c["preconditions"])),
        block("Planned test cases", table(CASE_COLS, c["cases"])),
        block("Test data", render_bullets(m["test_data"])),
        block("Notes", render_bullets(m["notes"])),
        block("Open questions", table(Q_COLS, c["questions"])),
    ])


TC_HEAD = re.compile(r"^(TC-[\w-]+)\s*[-–—:]\s*(.*)$")
META_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*-\s+\*\*([^*:]+):\*\*\s*(.*)$", re.M)


def split_blocks(text: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    blocks, cur = {"": []}, ""
    for line in text.splitlines():
        m = re.match(r"^\*\*(Preconditions|Steps|Postconditions)\*\*", line)
        if m:
            cur = m.group(1)
            blocks[cur] = []
        else:
            blocks[cur].append(line)
    return {k: "\n".join(v).strip() for k, v in blocks.items()}


def parse_test_case(meta, h1, sections):
    key = meta.get("scenario", "")
    cases, steps, unmapped = [], [], []
    for head, text in sections:
        hm = TC_HEAD.match(head)
        if not hm:
            unmapped.append(head)
            continue
        tc_id, title = hm.groups()
        b = split_blocks(text)
        info = {k.strip().lower(): v.strip() for k, v in META_RE.findall(b[""])}
        cases.append({"ref": key, "tc_id": tc_id, "title": title, "ac": info.get("ac", ""),
                      "type": info.get("type", ""), "priority": info.get("priority", ""),
                      "test_data": info.get("test data", ""),
                      "preconditions": parse_bullets(b.get("Preconditions", "")),
                      "postconditions": parse_bullets(b.get("Postconditions", ""))})
        steps += [{**r, "tc_id": tc_id} for r in rows_from_table(b.get("Steps", ""), STEP_COLS, key)]
    main = {"scenario": key, "story": meta.get("story", ""), "scenario_title": split_heading(h1, key),
            "status": meta.get("status", ""), "file": ""}
    return {"key": key, "main": main, "unmapped": unmapped, "children": {"cases": cases, "steps": steps}}


def render_test_case(doc):
    m, c = doc["main"], doc["children"]
    front = [("scenario", m["scenario"]), ("story", m["story"]), ("type", "test-case"), ("status", m["status"])]
    blocks = []
    for r in c["cases"]:
        steps = [s for s in c["steps"] if s["tc_id"] == r["tc_id"]]
        parts = [f"## {r['tc_id']} - {r['title']}\n",
                 f"- **Scenario:** {m['scenario']}\n- **AC:** {r['ac']}\n- **Type:** {r['type']}\n"
                 f"- **Priority:** {r['priority']}\n- **Test data:** {r['test_data']}\n",
                 f"**Preconditions**\n{render_bullets(r['preconditions'])}\n",
                 f"**Steps**\n\n{table(STEP_COLS, steps)}\n"]
        if r["postconditions"]:
            parts.append(f"**Postconditions**\n{render_bullets(r['postconditions'])}\n")
        blocks.append("\n".join(parts))
    return doc_text(front, f"Test cases for {m['scenario']} - {m['scenario_title']}", blocks)


def parse_test_data(meta, h1, sections):
    s, key = dict(sections), meta.get("scenario", "")
    text = s.get("Data sets", "")
    lines, tables = text.splitlines(), table_blocks(text)
    header, rows, extra = [], [], ""
    if tables:
        a, b = tables[0]
        header, rows = parse_table("\n".join(lines[a:b]))
        rest = "\n".join(lines[:a] + lines[b:]).strip()
    else:
        rest = text.strip()
    extra = "\n".join(l for l in rest.splitlines() if l.strip() != DATA_INTRO).strip()
    has_used = bool(header) and header[-1].lower() == "used by"
    names = header[3:-1] if has_used else header[3:]
    data = []
    for r in rows:
        r = r + [""] * (len(header) - len(r))
        data.append({"ref": key, "id": r[0], "purpose": r[1], "class": r[2],
                     "used_by": r[-1] if has_used else "", "fields": dict(zip(names, r[3:3 + len(names)]))})
    main = {"scenario": key, "story": meta.get("story", ""), "scenario_title": split_heading(h1, key),
            "status": meta.get("status", ""), "extra": extra,
            "conventions": parse_bullets(s.get("Conventions", "")), "file": ""}
    known = {"Data sets", "Conventions", "Open questions"}
    return {"key": key, "main": main, "unmapped": [h for h, _ in sections if h not in known],
            "children": {"data": data, "questions": rows_from_table(s.get("Open questions", ""), Q_COLS, key)}}


def render_test_data(doc):
    m, c = doc["main"], doc["children"]
    front = [("scenario", m["scenario"]), ("story", m["story"]), ("type", "test-data"), ("status", m["status"])]
    names = []
    for r in c["data"]:
        names += [n for n in r["fields"] if n not in names]
    rows = [[r["id"], r["purpose"], r["class"], *(r["fields"].get(n, "") for n in names), r["used_by"]]
            for r in c["data"]]
    data = f"{DATA_INTRO}\n\n" + render_table(["ID", "Purpose", "Class", *names, "Used by"], rows)
    if m["extra"]:
        data += "\n\n" + m["extra"]
    return doc_text(front, f"Test data for {m['scenario']} - {m['scenario_title']}", [
        block("Data sets", data), block("Conventions", render_bullets(m["conventions"])),
        block("Open questions", table(Q_COLS, c["questions"])),
    ])


ADAPTERS = {
    "user-story": (parse_user_story, render_user_story),
    "test-scenario": (parse_test_scenario, render_test_scenario),
    "test-case": (parse_test_case, render_test_case),
    "test-data": (parse_test_data, render_test_data),
}


def normalize(doc: dict) -> dict:
    doc["main"] = {k: norm_text(v) for k, v in doc["main"].items()}
    for rows in doc["children"].values():
        names = []
        for r in rows:
            for k, v in list(r.items()):
                r[k] = {n: norm_text(x) for n, x in v.items()} if k == "fields" else norm_text(v)
            names += [n for n in r.get("fields", {}) if n not in names]
        used = [n for n in names if any(r["fields"].get(n) for r in rows)]
        for r in rows:
            if "fields" in r:
                r["fields"] = {n: r["fields"].get(n, "") for n in used}
    return doc


def digest(doc: dict) -> str:
    payload = {"main": {k: v for k, v in doc["main"].items() if k != "file"}, "children": doc["children"]}
    return hashlib.sha1(json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()


def parse_md(text: str, tname: str) -> dict:
    meta, body = parse_frontmatter(text)
    h1, sections = split_h2(body)
    return normalize(ADAPTERS[tname][0](meta, h1, sections))


# ---------- workbook layer ----------

def style_sheet(ws, widths: dict[int, int] | None = None) -> None:
    for cell in ws[1]:
        cell.fill, cell.font, cell.alignment = HEADER_FILL, HEADER_FONT, WRAP
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2):
        for cell in row:
            cell.alignment = WRAP
    for i, w in (widths or {}).items():
        ws.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(i)].width = w
    ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
    ws.auto_filter.ref = ws.dimensions


def put_row(ws, r: int, values: list) -> None:
    for c, v in enumerate(values, start=1):
        cell = ws.cell(row=r, column=c, value=v)
        if isinstance(v, str) and v.startswith("="):
            cell.data_type = "s"  # keep text starting with "=" from becoming a formula


def build_template(tcfg: dict) -> Workbook:
    wb = Workbook()
    wb.remove(wb.active)
    for scfg in tcfg["sheets"].values():
        ws = wb.create_sheet(scfg["name"])
        keys = list(scfg["columns"])
        put_row(ws, 1, list(scfg["columns"].values()) + scfg.get("placeholders", []))
        style_sheet(ws, {i: WIDTHS.get(k, 16) for i, k in enumerate(keys, start=1)})
    wb.create_sheet(SYNC_SHEET).sheet_state = "hidden"
    return wb


def open_workbook(tname: str, tcfg: dict, path: Path) -> Workbook:
    if path.exists():
        return load_workbook(path)
    tpl = TEMPLATE_DIR / f"{tname}.xlsx"
    return load_workbook(tpl) if tpl.exists() else build_template(tcfg)


def read_docs(wb: Workbook, tcfg: dict) -> dict[str, dict]:
    docs: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for skey, scfg in tcfg["sheets"].items():
        if scfg["name"] not in wb.sheetnames:
            sys.exit(f"Sheet '{scfg['name']}' is missing; check assets/config.json or regenerate with 'template'.")
        rows = list(wb[scfg["name"]].iter_rows(values_only=True))
        header = [norm_text(h) for h in rows[0]] if rows else []
        labels = scfg["columns"]
        missing = [lbl for lbl in labels.values() if lbl not in header]
        if missing:
            sys.exit(f"Sheet '{scfg['name']}' lacks columns {missing}; the workbook does not match the config.")
        idx = {k: header.index(lbl) for k, lbl in labels.items()}
        dynamic = scfg.get("dynamic")
        extra = [(i, h) for i, h in enumerate(header) if h and h not in labels.values()] if dynamic else []
        for r in rows[1:]:
            row = {k: norm_text(r[i]) if i < len(r) else "" for k, i in idx.items()}
            if dynamic:
                row["fields"] = {h: norm_text(r[i]) if i < len(r) else "" for i, h in extra}
            if not any(v for k, v in row.items() if k != "fields") and not any(row.get("fields", {}).values()):
                continue
            if skey == "main":
                key = row[tcfg["key_field"]]
                if key:
                    docs[key] = {"key": key, "main": row, "unmapped": [],
                                 "children": {k: [] for k in tcfg["sheets"] if k != "main"}}
            elif row["ref"] in docs:
                docs[row["ref"]]["children"][skey].append(row)
    return {k: normalize(d) for k, d in docs.items()}


def write_docs(wb: Workbook, tcfg: dict, docs: dict[str, dict]) -> None:
    keys = sorted(docs)
    for skey, scfg in tcfg["sheets"].items():
        ws = wb[scfg["name"]]
        ws.delete_rows(1, ws.max_row + 1)
        cols = list(scfg["columns"].items())
        extra: list[str] = []
        if scfg.get("dynamic"):
            for k in keys:
                for r in docs[k]["children"].get(skey, []):
                    extra += [n for n in r.get("fields", {}) if n not in extra]
            extra = extra or scfg.get("placeholders", [])
        put_row(ws, 1, [lbl for _, lbl in cols] + extra)
        n = 1
        for k in keys:
            for r in [docs[k]["main"]] if skey == "main" else docs[k]["children"].get(skey, []):
                n += 1
                put_row(ws, n, [r.get(c, "") for c, _ in cols] + [r.get("fields", {}).get(x, "") for x in extra])
        widths = {i: WIDTHS.get(c, 16) for i, (c, _) in enumerate(cols, start=1)}
        widths.update({len(cols) + i: 18 for i in range(1, len(extra) + 1)})
        style_sheet(ws, widths)


def read_state(wb: Workbook) -> dict[str, str]:
    if SYNC_SHEET not in wb.sheetnames:
        return {}
    return {str(r[0]): str(r[1]) for r in wb[SYNC_SHEET].iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True) if r[0]}


def write_state(wb: Workbook, state: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    ws = wb[SYNC_SHEET] if SYNC_SHEET in wb.sheetnames else wb.create_sheet(SYNC_SHEET)
    ws.delete_rows(1, ws.max_row + 1)
    now = datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds")
    put_row(ws, 1, ["Key", "Hash", "Synced at"])
    for i, (k, h) in enumerate(sorted(state.items()), start=2):
        put_row(ws, i, [k, h, now])
    ws.sheet_state = "hidden"


# ---------- sync ----------

def slug(title: str) -> str:
    ascii_title = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title).encode("ascii", "ignore").decode().lower()
    return "-".join(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", ascii_title).split()[:5]) or "artifact"


def md_target(root: Path, tcfg: dict, tname: str, doc: dict, existing: dict | None) -> Path:
    folder = (root / tcfg["folder"]).resolve()
    if existing:
        return root / existing["main"]["file"]
    cand = doc["main"].get("file", "")
    if cand:
        p = (root / cand).resolve()
        if p.is_relative_to(folder) and p.suffix == ".md":
            return p
    title = doc["main"].get("title") or doc["main"].get("scenario_title", "")
    return folder / f"{doc['key']}-{slug(title)}{tcfg['glob'].lstrip('*')}"


def load_md(root: Path, tcfg: dict, tname: str) -> dict[str, dict]:
    docs = {}
    for path in sorted((root / tcfg["folder"]).glob(tcfg["glob"])):
        doc = parse_md(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), tname)
        if not doc["key"]:
            print(f"WARN  {path.name}: no key in frontmatter, skipped")
            continue
        doc["main"]["file"] = path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
        docs[doc["key"]] = doc
    return docs


def plan(m, x, base, prefer) -> str:
    hm, hx = (digest(m) if m else None), (digest(x) if x else None)
    if m and x:
        if hm == hx:
            return "in-sync"
        if base == hx:
            return "push"
        if base == hm:
            return "pull"
        return {"md": "push", "xlsx": "pull"}.get(prefer, "conflict")
    if m:
        return "push" if base is None or prefer == "md" else "xlsx-removed"
    return "pull" if base is None or prefer == "xlsx" else "md-removed"


def run_type(root: Path, cfg: dict, tname: str, args, apply: bool) -> int:
    tcfg = cfg["types"][tname]
    path = root / cfg["workbook_dir"] / tcfg["workbook"]
    wb = open_workbook(tname, tcfg, path)
    md, xd, state = load_md(root, tcfg, tname), None, None
    xd, state = read_docs(wb, tcfg), read_state(wb)
    new_state, dirty, problems = dict(state), False, 0
    for key in sorted(set(md) | set(xd)):
        if args.id and key != args.id:
            continue
        m, x = md.get(key), xd.get(key)
        action = plan(m, x, state.get(key), args.prefer)
        note = ""
        if action == "pull" and m and m["unmapped"] and args.prefer != "xlsx":
            action, note = "blocked", f"md has sections not mapped to xlsx {m['unmapped']}; pull would drop them"
        if action in ("conflict", "blocked", "xlsx-removed", "md-removed"):
            problems += 1
        print(f"{tname:14} {key:14} {action:13} {note}".rstrip())
        if not apply:
            continue
        if action == "push":
            xd[key], dirty = m, True
            new_state[key] = digest(m)
        elif action == "pull":
            target = md_target(root, tcfg, tname, x, m)
            text = ADAPTERS[tname][1](x)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with open(target, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
                f.write(text)
            if digest(parse_md(text, tname)) != digest(x):
                print(f"WARN  {target.name}: markdown does not round-trip to the xlsx content; review it")
            x["main"]["file"], dirty = target.relative_to(root).as_posix(), True
            new_state[key] = digest(x)
        elif action == "in-sync":
            new_state[key] = digest(m)
    if apply and (dirty or new_state != state):
        write_docs(wb, tcfg, xd)
        write_state(wb, new_state)
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            wb.save(path)
        except PermissionError:
            sys.exit(f"Cannot write {path}; close it in Excel and run again.")
    return problems


def cmd_template(root: Path, cfg: dict, args) -> int:
    out = Path(args.out) if args.out else TEMPLATE_DIR
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for tname in args.types:
        build_template(cfg["types"][tname]).save(out / f"{tname}.xlsx")
        print(f"Saved {out / (tname + '.xlsx')}")
    return 0


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, default=SKILL_DIR.parents[2], help="workspace root")
    parser.add_argument("--config", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_CONFIG)
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    for name in ("template", "status", "sync"):
        p = sub.add_parser(name)
        p.add_argument("--type", action="append", dest="types", help="artifact type (repeatable); default: all")
        if name == "template":
            p.add_argument("--out", help="output directory (default: assets/templates)")
        else:
            p.add_argument("--id", help="only this artifact key (e.g. US-KOS-01, TS-KOS-01)")
        if name == "sync":
            p.add_argument("--prefer", choices=["md", "xlsx"], help="resolve conflicts and removals in favour of one side")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    args.prefer = getattr(args, "prefer", None)
    args.id = getattr(args, "id", None)

    cfg = json.loads(args.config.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    unknown = [t for t in args.types or [] if t not in cfg["types"]]
    if unknown:
        sys.exit(f"Unknown type(s) {unknown}; available: {list(cfg['types'])}")
    args.types = args.types or list(cfg["types"])
    if args.command == "template":
        return cmd_template(args.root, cfg, args)
    problems = sum(run_type(args.root, cfg, t, args, apply=args.command == "sync") for t in args.types)
    return 1 if problems else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

```
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Two-way sync between user-story-writer markdown artifacts and Excel workbooks.

Markdown (docs/user-story, test-scenario, test-case, test-data) <-> one workbook per type.
Sheet and column names come from ../assets/config.json. See ../SKILL.md for the procedure.

    python excel_sync.py template [--type T] [--out DIR]
    python excel_sync.py status   [--type T] [--id ID]
    python excel_sync.py sync     [--type T] [--id ID] [--prefer md|xlsx]

Requires: pip install openpyxl
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import re
import sys
import unicodedata
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from openpyxl import Workbook, load_workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Alignment, Font, PatternFill
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

SKILL_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
DEFAULT_CONFIG = SKILL_DIR / "assets" / "config.json"
TEMPLATE_DIR = SKILL_DIR / "assets" / "templates"
SYNC_SHEET = "_sync"

HEADER_FILL = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="1F4E78")
HEADER_FONT = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
WRAP = Alignment(wrap_text=True, vertical="top")
WIDTHS = {
    "story": 50, "goal": 60, "notes": 80, "criterion": 60, "question": 60, "description": 60,
    "action": 50, "expected": 50, "title": 40, "purpose": 40, "preconditions": 50,
    "postconditions": 50, "conventions": 60, "extra": 60, "in_scope": 40, "out_of_scope": 40,
    "related": 40, "linked": 30, "file": 40, "heading": 40, "scenario_title": 40,
}

Q_COLS = [("no", "#"), ("question", "Question"), ("owner", "Owner"), ("status", "Status")]
PRE_COLS = [("no", "#"), ("condition", "Condition"), ("description", "Description")]
CASE_COLS = [("tc_id", "TC ID"), ("title", "Title"), ("type", "Type"), ("technique", "Technique"),
             ("priority", "Priority"), ("ac", "AC")]
STEP_COLS = [("no", "#"), ("action", "Action"), ("expected", "Expected result"), ("test_data", "Test data")]
DATA_INTRO = "Columns after `Class` are the input fields used by the scenario."


# ---------- markdown helpers ----------

def norm_text(v) -> str:
    if v is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(v, float) and v.is_integer():
        v = int(v)
    return re.sub(r"\r\n?", "\n", str(v)).strip()


def parse_frontmatter(text: str) -> tuple[dict, str]:
    m = re.match(r"^---\r?\n(.*?)\r?\n---\r?\n", text, re.S)
    if not m:
        return {}, text
    meta = {}
    for line in m.group(1).splitlines():
        k, sep, v = line.partition(":")
        if sep:
            meta[k.strip()] = v.strip().strip("\"'")
    return meta, text[m.end():]


def split_h2(body: str) -> tuple[str, list[tuple[str, str]]]:
    h1, sections = "", []
    for line in body.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("# ") and not h1 and not sections:
            h1 = line[2:].strip()
        elif line.startswith("## "):
            sections.append([line[3:].strip(), []])
        elif sections:
            sections[-1][1].append(line)
    return h1, [(h, "\n".join(t).strip()) for h, t in sections]


def split_heading(h1: str, key: str) -> str:
    m = re.search(rf"{re.escape(key)}\s*[-–—]\s*(.*)$", h1)
    return m.group(1).strip() if m else h1


def split_cells(line: str) -> list[str]:
    cells = re.split(r"(?<!\\)\|", line.strip().strip("|"))
    return [c.strip().replace("\\|", "|").replace("<br>", "\n") for c in cells]


def table_blocks(text: str) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
    """Line ranges [start, end) of contiguous table blocks."""
    lines, blocks, start = text.splitlines(), [], None
    for i, line in enumerate(lines + [""]):
        is_row = line.strip().startswith("|")
        if is_row and start is None:
            start = i
        elif not is_row and start is not None:
            blocks.append((start, i))
            start = None
    return blocks


def parse_table(text: str) -> tuple[list[str], list[list[str]]]:
    rows = []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if not line.strip().startswith("|"):
            continue
        cells = split_cells(line)
        if all(re.fullmatch(r":?-{3,}:?", c) for c in cells):
            continue
        rows.append(cells)
    return (rows[0], rows[1:]) if rows else ([], [])


def rows_from_table(text: str, cols: list[tuple[str, str]], ref: str) -> list[dict]:
    keys = [k for k, _ in cols]
    _, rows = parse_table(text)
    return [{"ref": ref, **dict(zip(keys, (r + [""] * len(keys))[:len(keys)]))} for r in rows]


def bullet_items(text: str) -> list[str]:
    return [m.group(1).strip() for m in re.finditer(r"^\s*[-*]\s+(.*)$", text, re.M)]


def parse_bullets(text: str) -> str:
    return "\n".join(bullet_items(text))


def render_table(header: list[str], rows: list[list[str]]) -> str:
    esc = lambda c: str(c).replace("|", "\\|").replace("\n", "<br>")
    lines = ["| " + " | ".join(esc(h) for h in header) + " |", "|" + "---|" * len(header)]
    lines += ["| " + " | ".join(esc(c) for c in r) + " |" for r in rows]
    return "\n".join(lines)


def table(cols: list[tuple[str, str]], rows: list[dict]) -> str:
    return render_table([h for _, h in cols], [[r[k] for k, _ in cols] for r in rows])


def render_bullets(value: str) -> str:
    return "\n".join(f"- {line}" for line in value.splitlines() if line.strip())


def yq(v: str) -> str:
    if v and re.search(r"(^[\s\[\]{}\"'&*!|>%@`#-]|:\s|\s#|\s$)", v):
        return json.dumps(v, ensure_ascii=False)
    return v


def block(title: str, body: str) -> str:
    return f"## {title}\n\n{body}".rstrip() + "\n"


def doc_text(front: list[tuple[str, str]], h1: str, blocks: list[str]) -> str:
    head = "---\n" + "\n".join(f"{k}: {v}" for k, v in front) + "\n---\n"
    return head + f"\n# {h1}\n\n" + "\n".join(blocks).rstrip() + "\n"


# ---------- adapters: markdown <-> canonical doc ----------
# doc = {"key", "main": {...}, "children": {sheet_key: [row, ...]}, "unmapped": [heading, ...]}

AC_RE = re.compile(r"^\*\*(AC-[\w-]+)\*\*\s*(?:\[(.*?)\])?\s*(.*)$", re.S)


def parse_user_story(meta, h1, sections):
    s, key = dict(sections), meta.get("id", "")
    scope = s.get("Scope", "")
    mi = re.search(r"\*\*In scope\*\*(.*?)(?=\*\*Out of scope\*\*|\Z)", scope, re.S)
    mo = re.search(r"\*\*Out of scope\*\*(.*)", scope, re.S)
    criteria = []
    for item in bullet_items(s.get("Acceptance criteria", "")):
        m = AC_RE.match(item)
        criteria.append({"ref": key, "ac": m.group(1), "source": m.group(2) or "", "criterion": m.group(3)}
                        if m else {"ref": key, "ac": "", "source": "", "criterion": item})
    main = {
        "id": key, "title": meta.get("title") or split_heading(h1, key), "status": meta.get("status", ""),
        "requirements": ", ".join(p.strip() for p in meta.get("requirements", "").strip("[]").split(",") if p.strip()),
        "story": s.get("Story", ""), "in_scope": parse_bullets(mi.group(1)) if mi else "",
        "out_of_scope": parse_bullets(mo.group(1)) if mo else "",
        "related": parse_bullets(s.get("Related requirements", "")),
        "linked": parse_bullets(s.get("Linked artifacts", "")), "file": "",
    }
    known = {"Story", "Acceptance criteria", "Scope", "Related requirements", "Linked artifacts", "Open questions"}
    return {"key": key, "main": main, "unmapped": [h for h, _ in sections if h not in known],
            "children": {"criteria": criteria,
                         "questions": rows_from_table(s.get("Open questions", ""), Q_COLS, key)}}


def render_user_story(doc):
    m, c = doc["main"], doc["children"]
    front = [("id", m["id"]), ("type", "user-story"), ("title", yq(m["title"])), ("status", m["status"]),
             ("requirements", f"[{m['requirements']}]")]
    ac = [f"- **{r['ac']}** " + (f"[{r['source']}] " if r["source"] else "") + r["criterion"] for r in c["criteria"]]
    scope = (f"**In scope**\n{render_bullets(m['in_scope'])}\n\n"
             f"**Out of scope**\n{render_bullets(m['out_of_scope'])}")
    return doc_text(front, f"{m['id']} - {m['title']}", [
        block("Story", m["story"]), block("Acceptance criteria", "\n".join(ac)), block("Scope", scope),
        block("Related requirements", render_bullets(m["related"])),
        block("Linked artifacts", render_bullets(m["linked"])),
        block("Open questions", table(Q_COLS, c["questions"])),
    ])


def parse_test_scenario(meta, h1, sections):
    s, key = dict(sections), meta.get("id", "")
    main = {
        "id": key, "story": meta.get("story", ""), "title": meta.get("title", ""),
        "heading": split_heading(h1, key), "status": meta.get("status", ""), "priority": meta.get("priority", ""),
        "goal": s.get("Goal", ""), "test_data": parse_bullets(s.get("Test data", "")),
        "notes": parse_bullets(s.get("Notes", "")), "file": "",
    }
    known = {"Goal", "Covered acceptance criteria", "Preconditions", "Planned test cases", "Test data",
             "Notes", "Open questions"}
    return {"key": key, "main": main, "unmapped": [h for h, _ in sections if h not in known],
            "children": {
                "covered_ac": [{"ref": key, "ac": i} for i in bullet_items(s.get("Covered acceptance criteria", ""))],
                "preconditions": rows_from_table(s.get("Preconditions", ""), PRE_COLS, key),
                "cases": rows_from_table(s.get("Planned test cases", ""), CASE_COLS, key),
                "questions": rows_from_table(s.get("Open questions", ""), Q_COLS, key)}}


def render_test_scenario(doc):
    m, c = doc["main"], doc["children"]
    front = [("id", m["id"]), ("type", "test-scenario"), ("story", m["story"]), ("title", yq(m["title"])),
             ("status", m["status"]), ("priority", m["priority"])]
    return doc_text(front, f"{m['id']} - {m['heading'] or m['title']}", [
        block("Goal", m["goal"]),
        block("Covered acceptance criteria", render_bullets("\n".join(r["ac"] for r in c["covered_ac"]))),
        block("Preconditions", table(PRE_COLS, c["preconditions"])),
        block("Planned test cases", table(CASE_COLS, c["cases"])),
        block("Test data", render_bullets(m["test_data"])),
        block("Notes", render_bullets(m["notes"])),
        block("Open questions", table(Q_COLS, c["questions"])),
    ])


TC_HEAD = re.compile(r"^(TC-[\w-]+)\s*[-–—:]\s*(.*)$")
META_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*-\s+\*\*([^*:]+):\*\*\s*(.*)$", re.M)


def split_blocks(text: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    blocks, cur = {"": []}, ""
    for line in text.splitlines():
        m = re.match(r"^\*\*(Preconditions|Steps|Postconditions)\*\*", line)
        if m:
            cur = m.group(1)
            blocks[cur] = []
        else:
            blocks[cur].append(line)
    return {k: "\n".join(v).strip() for k, v in blocks.items()}


def parse_test_case(meta, h1, sections):
    key = meta.get("scenario", "")
    cases, steps, unmapped = [], [], []
    for head, text in sections:
        hm = TC_HEAD.match(head)
        if not hm:
            unmapped.append(head)
            continue
        tc_id, title = hm.groups()
        b = split_blocks(text)
        info = {k.strip().lower(): v.strip() for k, v in META_RE.findall(b[""])}
        cases.append({"ref": key, "tc_id": tc_id, "title": title, "ac": info.get("ac", ""),
                      "type": info.get("type", ""), "priority": info.get("priority", ""),
                      "test_data": info.get("test data", ""),
                      "preconditions": parse_bullets(b.get("Preconditions", "")),
                      "postconditions": parse_bullets(b.get("Postconditions", ""))})
        steps += [{**r, "tc_id": tc_id} for r in rows_from_table(b.get("Steps", ""), STEP_COLS, key)]
    main = {"scenario": key, "story": meta.get("story", ""), "scenario_title": split_heading(h1, key),
            "status": meta.get("status", ""), "file": ""}
    return {"key": key, "main": main, "unmapped": unmapped, "children": {"cases": cases, "steps": steps}}


def render_test_case(doc):
    m, c = doc["main"], doc["children"]
    front = [("scenario", m["scenario"]), ("story", m["story"]), ("type", "test-case"), ("status", m["status"])]
    blocks = []
    for r in c["cases"]:
        steps = [s for s in c["steps"] if s["tc_id"] == r["tc_id"]]
        parts = [f"## {r['tc_id']} - {r['title']}\n",
                 f"- **Scenario:** {m['scenario']}\n- **AC:** {r['ac']}\n- **Type:** {r['type']}\n"
                 f"- **Priority:** {r['priority']}\n- **Test data:** {r['test_data']}\n",
                 f"**Preconditions**\n{render_bullets(r['preconditions'])}\n",
                 f"**Steps**\n\n{table(STEP_COLS, steps)}\n"]
        if r["postconditions"]:
            parts.append(f"**Postconditions**\n{render_bullets(r['postconditions'])}\n")
        blocks.append("\n".join(parts))
    return doc_text(front, f"Test cases for {m['scenario']} - {m['scenario_title']}", blocks)


def parse_test_data(meta, h1, sections):
    s, key = dict(sections), meta.get("scenario", "")
    text = s.get("Data sets", "")
    lines, tables = text.splitlines(), table_blocks(text)
    header, rows, extra = [], [], ""
    if tables:
        a, b = tables[0]
        header, rows = parse_table("\n".join(lines[a:b]))
        rest = "\n".join(lines[:a] + lines[b:]).strip()
    else:
        rest = text.strip()
    extra = "\n".join(l for l in rest.splitlines() if l.strip() != DATA_INTRO).strip()
    has_used = bool(header) and header[-1].lower() == "used by"
    names = header[3:-1] if has_used else header[3:]
    data = []
    for r in rows:
        r = r + [""] * (len(header) - len(r))
        data.append({"ref": key, "id": r[0], "purpose": r[1], "class": r[2],
                     "used_by": r[-1] if has_used else "", "fields": dict(zip(names, r[3:3 + len(names)]))})
    main = {"scenario": key, "story": meta.get("story", ""), "scenario_title": split_heading(h1, key),
            "status": meta.get("status", ""), "extra": extra,
            "conventions": parse_bullets(s.get("Conventions", "")), "file": ""}
    known = {"Data sets", "Conventions", "Open questions"}
    return {"key": key, "main": main, "unmapped": [h for h, _ in sections if h not in known],
            "children": {"data": data, "questions": rows_from_table(s.get("Open questions", ""), Q_COLS, key)}}


def render_test_data(doc):
    m, c = doc["main"], doc["children"]
    front = [("scenario", m["scenario"]), ("story", m["story"]), ("type", "test-data"), ("status", m["status"])]
    names = []
    for r in c["data"]:
        names += [n for n in r["fields"] if n not in names]
    rows = [[r["id"], r["purpose"], r["class"], *(r["fields"].get(n, "") for n in names), r["used_by"]]
            for r in c["data"]]
    data = f"{DATA_INTRO}\n\n" + render_table(["ID", "Purpose", "Class", *names, "Used by"], rows)
    if m["extra"]:
        data += "\n\n" + m["extra"]
    return doc_text(front, f"Test data for {m['scenario']} - {m['scenario_title']}", [
        block("Data sets", data), block("Conventions", render_bullets(m["conventions"])),
        block("Open questions", table(Q_COLS, c["questions"])),
    ])


ADAPTERS = {
    "user-story": (parse_user_story, render_user_story),
    "test-scenario": (parse_test_scenario, render_test_scenario),
    "test-case": (parse_test_case, render_test_case),
    "test-data": (parse_test_data, render_test_data),
}


def normalize(doc: dict) -> dict:
    doc["main"] = {k: norm_text(v) for k, v in doc["main"].items()}
    for rows in doc["children"].values():
        names = []
        for r in rows:
            for k, v in list(r.items()):
                r[k] = {n: norm_text(x) for n, x in v.items()} if k == "fields" else norm_text(v)
            names += [n for n in r.get("fields", {}) if n not in names]
        used = [n for n in names if any(r["fields"].get(n) for r in rows)]
        for r in rows:
            if "fields" in r:
                r["fields"] = {n: r["fields"].get(n, "") for n in used}
    return doc


def digest(doc: dict) -> str:
    payload = {"main": {k: v for k, v in doc["main"].items() if k != "file"}, "children": doc["children"]}
    return hashlib.sha1(json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()


def parse_md(text: str, tname: str) -> dict:
    meta, body = parse_frontmatter(text)
    h1, sections = split_h2(body)
    return normalize(ADAPTERS[tname][0](meta, h1, sections))


# ---------- workbook layer ----------

def style_sheet(ws, widths: dict[int, int] | None = None) -> None:
    for cell in ws[1]:
        cell.fill, cell.font, cell.alignment = HEADER_FILL, HEADER_FONT, WRAP
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2):
        for cell in row:
            cell.alignment = WRAP
    for i, w in (widths or {}).items():
        ws.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(i)].width = w
    ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
    ws.auto_filter.ref = ws.dimensions


def put_row(ws, r: int, values: list) -> None:
    for c, v in enumerate(values, start=1):
        cell = ws.cell(row=r, column=c, value=v)
        if isinstance(v, str) and v.startswith("="):
            cell.data_type = "s"  # keep text starting with "=" from becoming a formula


def build_template(tcfg: dict) -> Workbook:
    wb = Workbook()
    wb.remove(wb.active)
    for scfg in tcfg["sheets"].values():
        ws = wb.create_sheet(scfg["name"])
        keys = list(scfg["columns"])
        put_row(ws, 1, list(scfg["columns"].values()) + scfg.get("placeholders", []))
        style_sheet(ws, {i: WIDTHS.get(k, 16) for i, k in enumerate(keys, start=1)})
    wb.create_sheet(SYNC_SHEET).sheet_state = "hidden"
    return wb


def open_workbook(tname: str, tcfg: dict, path: Path) -> Workbook:
    if path.exists():
        return load_workbook(path)
    tpl = TEMPLATE_DIR / f"{tname}.xlsx"
    return load_workbook(tpl) if tpl.exists() else build_template(tcfg)


def read_docs(wb: Workbook, tcfg: dict) -> dict[str, dict]:
    docs: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for skey, scfg in tcfg["sheets"].items():
        if scfg["name"] not in wb.sheetnames:
            sys.exit(f"Sheet '{scfg['name']}' is missing; check assets/config.json or regenerate with 'template'.")
        rows = list(wb[scfg["name"]].iter_rows(values_only=True))
        header = [norm_text(h) for h in rows[0]] if rows else []
        labels = scfg["columns"]
        missing = [lbl for lbl in labels.values() if lbl not in header]
        if missing:
            sys.exit(f"Sheet '{scfg['name']}' lacks columns {missing}; the workbook does not match the config.")
        idx = {k: header.index(lbl) for k, lbl in labels.items()}
        dynamic = scfg.get("dynamic")
        extra = [(i, h) for i, h in enumerate(header) if h and h not in labels.values()] if dynamic else []
        for r in rows[1:]:
            row = {k: norm_text(r[i]) if i < len(r) else "" for k, i in idx.items()}
            if dynamic:
                row["fields"] = {h: norm_text(r[i]) if i < len(r) else "" for i, h in extra}
            if not any(v for k, v in row.items() if k != "fields") and not any(row.get("fields", {}).values()):
                continue
            if skey == "main":
                key = row[tcfg["key_field"]]
                if key:
                    docs[key] = {"key": key, "main": row, "unmapped": [],
                                 "children": {k: [] for k in tcfg["sheets"] if k != "main"}}
            elif row["ref"] in docs:
                docs[row["ref"]]["children"][skey].append(row)
    return {k: normalize(d) for k, d in docs.items()}


def write_docs(wb: Workbook, tcfg: dict, docs: dict[str, dict]) -> None:
    keys = sorted(docs)
    for skey, scfg in tcfg["sheets"].items():
        ws = wb[scfg["name"]]
        ws.delete_rows(1, ws.max_row + 1)
        cols = list(scfg["columns"].items())
        extra: list[str] = []
        if scfg.get("dynamic"):
            for k in keys:
                for r in docs[k]["children"].get(skey, []):
                    extra += [n for n in r.get("fields", {}) if n not in extra]
            extra = extra or scfg.get("placeholders", [])
        put_row(ws, 1, [lbl for _, lbl in cols] + extra)
        n = 1
        for k in keys:
            for r in [docs[k]["main"]] if skey == "main" else docs[k]["children"].get(skey, []):
                n += 1
                put_row(ws, n, [r.get(c, "") for c, _ in cols] + [r.get("fields", {}).get(x, "") for x in extra])
        widths = {i: WIDTHS.get(c, 16) for i, (c, _) in enumerate(cols, start=1)}
        widths.update({len(cols) + i: 18 for i in range(1, len(extra) + 1)})
        style_sheet(ws, widths)


def read_state(wb: Workbook) -> dict[str, str]:
    if SYNC_SHEET not in wb.sheetnames:
        return {}
    return {str(r[0]): str(r[1]) for r in wb[SYNC_SHEET].iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True) if r[0]}


def write_state(wb: Workbook, state: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    ws = wb[SYNC_SHEET] if SYNC_SHEET in wb.sheetnames else wb.create_sheet(SYNC_SHEET)
    ws.delete_rows(1, ws.max_row + 1)
    now = datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds")
    put_row(ws, 1, ["Key", "Hash", "Synced at"])
    for i, (k, h) in enumerate(sorted(state.items()), start=2):
        put_row(ws, i, [k, h, now])
    ws.sheet_state = "hidden"


# ---------- sync ----------

def slug(title: str) -> str:
    ascii_title = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title).encode("ascii", "ignore").decode().lower()
    return "-".join(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", ascii_title).split()[:5]) or "artifact"


def md_target(root: Path, tcfg: dict, tname: str, doc: dict, existing: dict | None) -> Path:
    folder = (root / tcfg["folder"]).resolve()
    if existing:
        return root / existing["main"]["file"]
    cand = doc["main"].get("file", "")
    if cand:
        p = (root / cand).resolve()
        if p.is_relative_to(folder) and p.suffix == ".md":
            return p
    title = doc["main"].get("title") or doc["main"].get("scenario_title", "")
    return folder / f"{doc['key']}-{slug(title)}{tcfg['glob'].lstrip('*')}"


def load_md(root: Path, tcfg: dict, tname: str) -> dict[str, dict]:
    docs = {}
    for path in sorted((root / tcfg["folder"]).glob(tcfg["glob"])):
        doc = parse_md(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), tname)
        if not doc["key"]:
            print(f"WARN  {path.name}: no key in frontmatter, skipped")
            continue
        doc["main"]["file"] = path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
        docs[doc["key"]] = doc
    return docs


def plan(m, x, base, prefer) -> str:
    hm, hx = (digest(m) if m else None), (digest(x) if x else None)
    if m and x:
        if hm == hx:
            return "in-sync"
        if base == hx:
            return "push"
        if base == hm:
            return "pull"
        return {"md": "push", "xlsx": "pull"}.get(prefer, "conflict")
    if m:
        return "push" if base is None or prefer == "md" else "xlsx-removed"
    return "pull" if base is None or prefer == "xlsx" else "md-removed"


def run_type(root: Path, cfg: dict, tname: str, args, apply: bool) -> int:
    tcfg = cfg["types"][tname]
    path = root / cfg["workbook_dir"] / tcfg["workbook"]
    wb = open_workbook(tname, tcfg, path)
    md, xd, state = load_md(root, tcfg, tname), None, None
    xd, state = read_docs(wb, tcfg), read_state(wb)
    new_state, dirty, problems = dict(state), False, 0
    for key in sorted(set(md) | set(xd)):
        if args.id and key != args.id:
            continue
        m, x = md.get(key), xd.get(key)
        action = plan(m, x, state.get(key), args.prefer)
        note = ""
        if action == "pull" and m and m["unmapped"] and args.prefer != "xlsx":
            action, note = "blocked", f"md has sections not mapped to xlsx {m['unmapped']}; pull would drop them"
        if action in ("conflict", "blocked", "xlsx-removed", "md-removed"):
            problems += 1
        print(f"{tname:14} {key:14} {action:13} {note}".rstrip())
        if not apply:
            continue
        if action == "push":
            xd[key], dirty = m, True
            new_state[key] = digest(m)
        elif action == "pull":
            target = md_target(root, tcfg, tname, x, m)
            text = ADAPTERS[tname][1](x)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with open(target, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
                f.write(text)
            if digest(parse_md(text, tname)) != digest(x):
                print(f"WARN  {target.name}: markdown does not round-trip to the xlsx content; review it")
            x["main"]["file"], dirty = target.relative_to(root).as_posix(), True
            new_state[key] = digest(x)
        elif action == "in-sync":
            new_state[key] = digest(m)
    if apply and (dirty or new_state != state):
        write_docs(wb, tcfg, xd)
        write_state(wb, new_state)
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            wb.save(path)
        except PermissionError:
            sys.exit(f"Cannot write {path}; close it in Excel and run again.")
    return problems


def cmd_template(root: Path, cfg: dict, args) -> int:
    out = Path(args.out) if args.out else TEMPLATE_DIR
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for tname in args.types:
        build_template(cfg["types"][tname]).save(out / f"{tname}.xlsx")
        print(f"Saved {out / (tname + '.xlsx')}")
    return 0


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, default=SKILL_DIR.parents[2], help="workspace root")
    parser.add_argument("--config", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_CONFIG)
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    for name in ("template", "status", "sync"):
        p = sub.add_parser(name)
        p.add_argument("--type", action="append", dest="types", help="artifact type (repeatable); default: all")
        if name == "template":
            p.add_argument("--out", help="output directory (default: assets/templates)")
        else:
            p.add_argument("--id", help="only this artifact key (e.g. US-KOS-01, TS-KOS-01)")
        if name == "sync":
            p.add_argument("--prefer", choices=["md", "xlsx"], help="resolve conflicts and removals in favour of one side")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    args.prefer = getattr(args, "prefer", None)
    args.id = getattr(args, "id", None)

    cfg = json.loads(args.config.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    unknown = [t for t in args.types or [] if t not in cfg["types"]]
    if unknown:
        sys.exit(f"Unknown type(s) {unknown}; available: {list(cfg['types'])}")
    args.types = args.types or list(cfg["types"])
    if args.command == "template":
        return cmd_template(args.root, cfg, args)
    problems = sum(run_type(args.root, cfg, t, args, apply=args.command == "sync") for t in args.types)
    return 1 if problems else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

```

````
# Excel Sync

Dwukierunkowa synchronizacja artefaktów z [user-story-writer](../user-story-writer/SKILL.md) (markdown w `docs/`) z arkuszami Excel. Markdown jest zapisem źródłowym; Excel służy do przeglądu, filtrowania i edycji tabelarycznej.

## Zasoby (stała część skilla)

| Zasób | Rola |
|---|---|
| [config.json](./assets/config.json) | Nazwy skoroszytów, arkuszy i kolumn; folder docelowy `docs/excel/` |
| [assets/templates/](./assets/templates/) | Puste szablony xlsx, po jednym na typ: `user-story.xlsx`, `test-scenario.xlsx`, `test-case.xlsx`, `test-data.xlsx` |
| [excel_sync.py](./scripts/excel_sync.py) | Skrypt: `template`, `status`, `sync` |

Skoroszyty robocze: `docs/excel/<user-stories|test-scenarios|test-cases|test-data>.xlsx` (tworzone z szablonu przy pierwszej synchronizacji).

## Model

- Klucz artefaktu: `id` (user-story, test-scenario) lub `scenario` (test-case, test-data). Zmiana klucza w pliku lub arkuszu oznacza nowy artefakt.
- Arkusz główny ma jeden wiersz na plik markdown (kolumna `File` jest informacyjna). Arkusze podrzędne (kryteria AC, kroki, pytania, zestawy danych itd.) wiążą się z nim kolumną `... ID`.
- W test-data kolumny pól wejściowych (po `Used by`) są dynamiczne: dodawaj je w Excelu po prawej stronie.
- Ukryty arkusz `_sync` trzyma skrót ostatnio zsynchronizowanej treści. Nie edytuj go i nie usuwaj.
- Wyniki `status` dla klucza:

| Wynik | Znaczenie | Akcja `sync` |
|---|---|---|
| `in-sync` | brak różnic | brak |
| `push` | zmieniony markdown (lub nowy) | md -> xlsx |
| `pull` | zmieniony xlsx (lub nowy wiersz) | xlsx -> md |
| `conflict` | zmieniono obie strony | pomija; wymaga decyzji |
| `blocked` | pull zgubiłby sekcje md spoza mapowania | pomija; wymaga decyzji |
| `md-removed` / `xlsx-removed` | artefakt usunięty po jednej stronie | pomija; wymaga decyzji |

## Procedura

### 1. Wejście

1. Ustal typy i/lub ID z prośby (`--type`, `--id`). Brak wejścia: wszystkie typy.
2. Jeśli użytkownik prosi tylko o pusty szablon lub zmianę nazw arkuszy/kolumn, przejdź do kroku 6.
3. Sprawdź zależność: `python -c "import openpyxl"`. Brak: zaproponuj `pip install openpyxl`.

### 2. Status (dry run)

```bash
python .github/skills/excel-sync/scripts/excel_sync.py status [--type T] [--id ID]
```

Pokaż użytkownikowi tabelę wyników. Nic nie jest zapisywane.

### 3. Decyzje

- `in-sync`, `push`, `pull`: nie pytaj, chyba że `pull` dotyczy pliku `accepted` (potwierdź przed nadpisaniem).
- `conflict`: dla każdego klucza zapytaj (`vscode_askQuestions`), która strona wygrywa: `md`, `xlsx` albo pomiń. Domyślnie: pomiń. Nie rozstrzygaj za użytkownika.
- `blocked`: wskaż sekcje md, które nie mają odpowiednika w xlsx; zapytaj, czy je zgubić (`--prefer xlsx`) czy pominąć.
- `md-removed` / `xlsx-removed`: zapytaj, czy odtworzyć artefakt (`--prefer xlsx` odtwarza md, `--prefer md` odtwarza wiersze w xlsx) czy pominąć.
- Plik xlsx otwarty w Excelu blokuje zapis. Poproś o zamknięcie przed `sync`.

### 4. Synchronizacja

```bash
python .github/skills/excel-sync/scripts/excel_sync.py sync [--type T] [--id ID] [--prefer md|xlsx]
```

- Bez `--prefer` skrypt synchronizuje tylko jednoznaczne przypadki.
- `--prefer` stosuj tylko z `--id` i po decyzji użytkownika z kroku 3.
- `pull` generuje markdown od nowa w formacie szablonu user-story-writer (zachowuje końce linii istniejącego pliku). Zagnieżdżone listy zostają spłaszczone, a wstęp sekcji `Data sets` jest odtwarzany.
- Komunikat `WARN ... does not round-trip` oznacza, że wygenerowany markdown różni się treścią od xlsx: sprawdź plik.

### 5. Weryfikacja i zakończenie

1. Uruchom `status` jeszcze raz; oczekiwane `in-sync` dla wszystkich zsynchronizowanych kluczy.
2. Po każdym `pull` pokaż zmienione pliki md (`git diff`) i zaproponuj przegląd wg checklisty user-story-writer (np. `TBD` bez wpisu w `Open questions`, AC bez przypadku testowego).
3. Podaj: ścieżki zmienionych md i xlsx, liczbę kluczy per wynik, pominięte konflikty.

### 6. Szablon i konfiguracja

- Zmiana nazw arkuszy lub kolumn: edytuj tylko etykiety (wartości) w [config.json](./assets/config.json); klucze wewnętrzne (lewa strona) i klucz `key_field` zostaw bez zmian.
- Po zmianie wygeneruj szablony: `python .github/skills/excel-sync/scripts/excel_sync.py template [--type T]`.
- Istniejące skoroszyty w `docs/excel/` nie migrują się same. Skrypt zatrzyma się z listą brakujących arkuszy/kolumn; zmień ich nazwy ręcznie lub usuń skoroszyt i zsynchronizuj od nowa (stan `_sync` zniknie, więc pierwsze różnice będą `conflict`).
- Nowe typy artefaktów i nowe kolumny wymagają zmiany adaptera w skrypcie; nie dopisuj ich tylko w configu.

## Zasady twarde

- Nie edytuj plików md ani xlsx ręcznie w ramach tego skilla; zmiany robi skrypt.
- Nie wybieraj `--prefer` samodzielnie.
- Nie czytaj `docs/ai-sessions/*` ani `zgloszenia/*`.

````
